briefs.summary: Cincinnati scored in four different innings Wednesday and held on in a slugfest, snapping a two-game skid; the Reds remain last in the NL Central with 28 games left.

briefs.headline: Padres blank the Pirates 3-0 to even the series
briefs.summary: A night after Pittsburgh's 1-0 shutout win, San Diego returned it Wednesday — the Pirates' bats going quiet in a series where every game has been decided by three runs or fewer.

waters.working: Settling toward summer low, off 132 a day ago - stay long and light: small caddis and stonefly nymphs through the pocket water, and watch the undercut banks late as the light goes off the water.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 25.4 ft and rising - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Half a foot of rise on a normal pool moves bait onto the wing dams - shad are the forage, so a white swimbait worked across the current seams early still reads right.

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 26.3 ft and falling - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Still easing off the mid-August rise; with the water greening, a crawfish-pattern crankbait ticked along the riprap and the lock wall is the steady play.

waters.reading: Sound highs 8:13 AM at 3.4 ft and 8:40 PM at 4.1 ft at Hampstead; lows 2:26 AM at 0.7 ft and 2:31 PM at 0.5 ft.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 8:13 AM and 8:40 PM in the sound.
waters.working: Tonight's moon is full at 99% - peak spring tides, so the ebb off the 8:13 high will pull hard to the half-foot low at 2:31 PM; that long fall is the red drum window, topwater plugs early and cut menhaden once the sun is up. Water 83.8F at Beaufort, 60 miles up the coast. The Fisherman's Post monthly, published Aug. 3 and 24 days old, has flounder thick in the sound - worth noting with the season opening Tuesday.
waters.note: Hampstead is the sound station and the read that matters; the oceanfront pier runs well ahead and is quoted only for a surf read. No hazards posted for Topsail this morning per NWS Wilmington.
